summary:
**Conversation Overview**

The user contacted Claude regarding a technical and billing issue with Claude Code, where approximately 50,000 tokens from their weekly allowance were consumed during a session that failed to produce the requested Python program. The output file Claude Code claimed to have created did not exist at the specified location, resulting in a complete loss of tokens with no deliverable.

The user asked for guidance on how to contact Anthropic to report the issue and seek token restoration or credit. Claude provided several contact options: live chat support via support.claude.com, accessing support directly through the Claude.ai interface, emailing support@anthropic.com for a documented paper trail, and filing a bug report on the Claude Code GitHub repository at github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues. Claude also advised the user to gather specific information before contacting support, including the date and time of the failed session, the nature of the requested program, the file path where output was expected, and any available screenshots.

Claude characterized the situation as a clear-cut case for token restoration given that the task produced zero output despite significant token consumption.
